messages:
sophia: rolling out release v3.14.2 to prod in 5m. starting with traffic slice=3% -> 25 -> 100. tagging rollback quickplay: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-express-v1.5 :triangular_flag_on_post:

devops-bot: [deploy] release=v3.14.2 initiated  slice=3%  by=sophia  changelist=GH:3589

kevin: Quick heads-up: this touches streaming-parser + tokenizer cache. if we need a rollback we must also clear the cache and toggle parser-ff off. runbook has exact steps.

sophia: paste for fast abort (copy/paste):
```
# abort deploy and pin to last stable
./infra/deployctl abort --release v3.14.2 --reason "canary fail"
./infra/deployctl pin --service text-gen --version v3.14.0
# clear tokenizer cache (if warm-up anomalies)
./infra/cachectl flush --service tokenizer --scope prod
# manual route if automation fails:
/ops/route switch --from v3.14.2 --to v3.14.0 --immediate
```

tilly (sre): Monitoring hooks:
- datadog: service.text-gen.errors (1m & 5m), service.text-gen.p95
- dd trace: text-gen.operation.generate failure rate
- infra: node.cpu and GPU mem pressure alerts
Abort if errors > 0.9% for ~4m or p95 > 400ms for 5m.

kevin: who owns the manual unroute if deploy automation is flaky?

sophia: I'll own automated unpin. Kevin will do the manual route if we're paged. Tilly will sound the alarm and escalate to eng-oncall.

devops-bot: [status] slice(3%) stable  observed_errors=0.05%  p95=180ms  elapsed=4m

kevin: adding an ops note: DB featureflag streaming_parser -> OFF before pinning. runbook step 3 has the RBAC command.

sophia: adding short comms rule: if you post a single-line starting with "ABORT:" the deploy-bot will attempt to abort automatically. be explicit (reason).

tilly (sre): set temporary alert to ping this thread at errors > 0.7% for 3m. also added a synthetic check hitting /v1/generate to ensure correctness.

devops-bot: [progress] promoted slice -> 25%  release=v3.14.2  started_at=4851236796

sophia: release-note draft: "v3.14.2 updates parser for short-prompt perf; gradual rollout. rollback reverts parser flag and pins to v3.14.0." will post after 25% stable.

tilly (sre): watching. if we see elevated cache miss rate, do not promote further until tokenizers warm up for 10m.

kevin: ack. I've copied the manual commands into my runbook snippet in case the bot can't reach infra.

devops-bot: [final] 25% stable at +6m  metrics nominal  continuing per schedule. remember rollback quickplay: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-express-v1.5

sophia: Thanks everyone  will keep this thread open for post-rollout validation and a brief runbook tweak to note the extra cache flush step. :white_check_mark:
